verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a mobile app that supports search and capture on the go, and search works offline on all devices. However, its own docs call the app "a companion to desktop," which cuts against the story's "not a stripped-down companion" premise. Missing for 10: evidence of full linking and backlinks/graph on mobile, explicit iOS and Android parity with desktop, and independent hands-on confirmation of mobile feature depth.

support.subject: As a power-user, full-featured iOS and Android apps give me my whole knowledge base — capture, search, and linking — not a stripped-down companion

citations.quote: The mobile app is a companion to desktop for day-to-day work in your space: search and capture on the go.
It works offline on all devices, giving you quick search results every time.
